alt: Hypophyseal portal system. Hypothalamic neurosecretory cells release hormone into a primary capillary plexus at the top of the infundibulum; hypophyseal portal veins carry it down to a secondary capillary plexus in the anterior pituitary, which then releases its own hormone into the blood. The pale posterior pituitary lies behind the anterior lobe. The figure shows vasculature, not the individual anterior-pituitary cell types.
